test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On 1 March 2022, how many teachers across India were bestowed the National Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Awards 2022 by the Union Minister of State for Education Annpurna Devi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: 49**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On 1 March 2022, the Union Minister of State for Education Annpurna Devi honored 49 teachers from across India with the National ICT Awards 2022.
 
• The awards recognize the innovative and effective integration of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in school education.
 
• The National ICT Awards aim to motivate and acknowledge teachers who have significantly contributed to enhancing the quality of education through ICT.
 
• The awardees are selected based on their innovative teaching practices, the extent of ICT integration, and the impact on students' learning outcomes.
 
• Each awardee receives a commendation certificate, a silver medal, and a cash prize.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National ICT Awards:**

 
 
• Instituted by the Ministry of Education, Government of India.
 
• Aim to promote the use of ICT in education and recognize outstanding contributions by teachers.
 
• Encourage teachers to use ICT tools for innovative and effective teaching practices.
 
 
 
• **ICT in Education:**
 
 
• Refers to the use of Information and Communication Technologies in teaching and learning processes.
 
• Includes the use of digital tools, online resources, and educational software.
 
• Aims to enhance students' engagement and improve learning outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Role of ICT in Enhancing Education:**
 
 
• Facilitates personalized learning experiences for students.
 
• Enables access to a wide range of educational resources and materials.
 
• Supports collaborative learning through online platforms and tools.
 
• Helps in developing students' digital literacy skills.
 
 
 
• **Selection Criteria for National ICT Awards:**
 
 
• Innovative use of ICT in teaching.
 
• Impact on students' learning outcomes.
 
• Extent of ICT integration in lesson plans and curriculum.
 
• Contribution to the professional development of peers through ICT.
